env:
  seed: 42
  device: cuda
  gpu_id: '7'
  gpu_memory_limit_mib: 35000
  gpu_reserve_cache: true
  preload_gpu: true
data:
  data_dir: <DATA_DIR>
  val_split: 0.15
  batch_size: 24
  num_workers: 4
  pin_memory: true
  drop_last: false
  dataset: slicewise
  preprocess: normalize_b0_mean
  orientation: axial
  augment:
  - name: flip_x
    p: 0.5
  - name: flip_y
    p: 0.5
model:
  name: spatial
  spatial:
    use_KAN: false
    use_VAE: false
    encoder:
      type: UNet
      enc_ch: 64
      enc_layers: 1
      hidden: 96
      num_layers: 4
      use_gn: true
      residual: true
      dilation: 1
      stride: 1
      attention:
        enabled: true
        reduction: 16
        kernel_size: 7
        use_channel_attn: true
        use_spatial_attn: true
    decoder:
      hidden: 384
      num_layers: 5
      neck: 128
      dropout: 0.0
training:
  epochs: 700
  lr: 0.0007
  log_every: 1
  ckpt_every: 10
  grad_clip: 0.75
  optimizer:
    name: adamw
    adam:
      weight_decay: 0.0
    adamw:
      weight_decay: 0.0001
    sgd:
      momentum: 0.9
      weight_decay: 0.0
  scheduler:
    name: warmup_plateau
    warmup_plateau:
      warmup_epochs: 20
      mode: min
      factor: 0.5
      patience: 18
      min_lr: 1.0e-06
      eta_min: 0.0
    plateau:
      mode: min
      factor: 0.5
      patience: 18
      min_lr: 1.0e-06
    cosine_warmup:
      warmup_epochs: 20
      T_max: 700
      eta_min: 1.0e-06
      last_epoch: -1
    cosine:
      T_max: 700
      eta_min: 1.0e-06
    cosine_warm_restart:
      T_0: 80
      T_mult: 2
      eta_min: 1.0e-06
      warmup_epochs: 20
    step:
      step_size: 80
      gamma: 0.5
    exponential:
      gamma: 0.98
  early_stopping:
    enabled: true
    patience: 90
    min_delta: 1.0e-07
loss:
  data_consistency:
    shell_weighting: none
    shell_weights:
    - 1.0
    - 1.0
    MSE:
      weight: 1.0
    MAE:
      weight: 0.0
    Huber:
      weight: 0.03
      beta: 0.03
    SSIM:
      weight: 0.02
    Rician:
      weight: 0.0
      s_noise: auto
  KL:
    weight: 0.0
    beta: 1.0
  parameter_map:
    TV:
      weight: 0.01
    CoordGradL2:
      weight: 0.0
      normalize: true

    CoordFiniteDiffL2:
      weight: 0.0
